import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Modular {
        private static int modValue = 0;
        private int value;

        public Modular() {
            this.value = 0;
        }

        public Modular(int value) {
            this.value = normalize(value);
        }

        public static void setMod(int m) {
            modValue = m;
        }

        private static int normalize(int x) {
            int v;
            if (-modValue <= x && x < modValue) {
                v = x;
            } else {
                v = x % modValue;
            }
            if (v < 0) v += modValue;
            return v;
        }

        public int getValue() {
            return value;
        }

        public Modular add(Modular other) {
            value = (value + other.value);
            if (value >= modValue) value -= modValue;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular sub(Modular other) {
            value = (value - other.value);
            if (value < 0) value += modValue;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular mul(Modular other) {
            long x = (long) value * other.value;
            value = (int) (x % modValue);
            return this;
        }

        public Modular div(Modular other) {
            return this.mul(other.inverse());
        }

        public Modular inverse() {
            return new Modular(modInverse(value, modValue));
        }

        private static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
            int u = 0, v = 1;
            int originalM = m;
            while (a != 0) {
                int t = m / a;
                m -= t * a;
                int temp = a;
                a = m;
                m = temp;
                u -= t * v;
                temp = u;
                u = v;
                v = temp;
            }
            if (m != 1) {
                throw new ArithmeticException("Modular inverse does not exist");
            }
            return (u % originalM + originalM) % originalM;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(value);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int md = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Modular.setMod(md);

        List<Modular> fact = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Modular> invFact = new ArrayList<>();
        fact.add(new Modular(1));
        invFact.add(new Modular(1));

        Modular[][] dp = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        Modular[][] ways = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new Modular(0);
                ways[i][j] = new Modular(0);
            }
        }
        ways[0][0] = new Modular(1);

        Modular[] ptrDp = new Modular[m + 1];
        Modular[] ptrWays = new Modular[m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ptrDp[i] = new Modular(0);
            ptrWays[i] = new Modular(0);
        }
        ptrWays[0] = new Modular(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                ptrWays[i] = ptrWays[i].add(ptrWays[l].mul(ptrWays[r]).mul(combination(l + r, l, fact, invFact)).mul(new Modular(l + r + 2)));
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular add = new Modular(l).mul(new Modular(l + 1)).add(new Modular(r).mul(new Modular(r + 1))).div(new Modular(2));
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add(ptrWays[l].mul(ptrWays[r]).mul(combination(l + r, l, fact, invFact)).mul(add));
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add((ptrDp[l].mul(ptrWays[r]).add(ptrDp[r].mul(ptrWays[l]))).mul(combination(l + r, r, fact, invFact)).mul(new Modular(l + r + 2)));
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptrDp[s];
                    ways[i][s] = ptrWays[s];
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; d++) {
                    Modular ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    Modular way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    int add = d - 1;
                    ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(way.mul(ptrWays[add]).mul(combination(s, add, fact, invFact)));
                    dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add((way.mul(ptrDp[add]).add(ptrWays[add].mul(ft))).mul(combination(s, add, fact, invFact)));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[n][m].getValue());
    }

    private static Modular combination(int x, int y, List<Modular> fact, List<Modular> invFact) {
        int sz = Math.max(x, y);
        while (fact.size() < sz + 1) {
            int size = fact.size();
            fact.add(fact.get(size - 1).mul(new Modular(size)));
            invFact.add(new Modular(1).div(fact.get(size)));
        }
        if (y < 0 || y > x) {
            return new Modular(0);
        }
        return fact.get(x).mul(invFact.get(y)).mul(invFact.get(x - y));
    }
}
